title: Connected explicit SendUnitData frame
purpose: Exercise the connected CPF layout with distinct connected address and connected data items, including a bounded sequenced CIP request.

messages.label: SendUnitData with Connected Address and Connected Data

expected_behavior: The server validates the SendUnitData encapsulation and CPF item lengths, then may process the connected request or return a normal invalid-session, connection, or CIP error because the connection identifier and service semantics are conservative inferred values.
constraints_preserved: 24-byte encapsulation header with command 0x0070 and payload length 0x001c
SendUnitData payload contains interface handle, timeout, CPF count two, and two ordered CPF items
Connected Address Item type 0x0100 has a four-byte connection identifier
Connected Data Item type 0x00B1 has eight bytes consisting of a two-byte sequence value and six-byte CIP data
All nested item lengths equal the bytes transmitted
issue_safety_notes: Safe connected-parser analogue informed by the documented SendUnitData path. It uses bounded identifiers and lengths, does not claim a real ForwardOpen-created connection, and does not reproduce malformed connected-data or historical vulnerability payloads.
